limitations: Generic Level-1 device models have no foundry calibration, layout parasitics, process/temperature variation or fabricated validation.
Charge-pump trigger and switch/behavioral payload are A2-inspired simulation abstractions, not A2 physical replication.
Circuit function is validated under declared normal stimulus only; it is not exhaustive proof of equivalence.
Known-positive parameter tuning used no LLM detector feedback and preceded experiment freeze.
